s01: Where you'll spend all of your time in Onshape is here, in the workspace. Down the left is the feature list: every sketch, every part, everything you make, in order. Across the top is the toolbar, and it changes to match what you're doing. Out in the middle is the space itself. You can see three planes: a front, a top, and a right, which stand in for our three dimensions. Right-click and drag to spin the view around, and you're turning this cube in the top right corner. You can also click the cube's faces to jump straight to a view. Back looks from behind, a corner gives you an angle, and this one is the front. And that's how you find your way around a three-dimensional space.
